title: Understanding PCA
text: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to emphasize variation and bring out strong patterns in a dataset. It is often used to make data easy to explore and visualize.

title: Linear Combinations in PCA
text: In PCA, the principal components are linear combinations of the original features. This means each principal component is a weighted sum of the original variables.

title: Dimensionality Reduction
text: PCA is commonly used for dimensionality reduction, which helps in reducing the number of variables in a dataset while preserving as much information as possible.

title: True or False: PCA Constructs Latent Features
text: The latent features constructed by PCA are linear combinations of the original features. Is this statement true or false?
